g.text: withdrawal follows Setup and the state at the end of setup is inherited for all entities except Iso which loses state on shutdown.

"_i" in variable name indicates an integer less than 5, identifying peers, any operation done on this kind of variable is done on each element of a vector containing every peers' version of that value.
Boomlet's niso_0_event_block_height is updated with freshly received value in each message containing it.
Each message is represented by a name composed of stage||sender||receiver||# in which # represents the #th message from sender to receiver in that stage.
In the withdrawal diagram peer_0 represents the peer that initiates the transaction and peer_1 represents one of the non-initiator peers.
Each entity inside user-side box of each peer_i is represented by entityName_i.
Some steps between initiator and non-initiator run asynchronously and concurrently, these steps when associated with non-initiator are denoted by an 'n' character at the end of step#.
User generates PSBT using a otherwise independent watch-only wallet module.
Niso receives psbt from User. Niso checks that most_work_bitcoin_block_height has passed milestone_block_0 from boomerang_descriptor,
derives tx_id from psbt and stores it. Niso also checks to see if psbt inputs are satisfiable. It sends the psbt alongside the latest
Boomlet receives {psbt, niso_0_event_block_height} from Niso and checks to see if the niso_0_event_block_height has passed
milestone_block_0. Boomlet then derives tx_id from psbt, creates st_preview_nonce, uses st_preview_nonce for ST freshness, encrypts it for st_0_identity_pubkey and sends the envelope to Niso.

tx_id_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_st := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", st_0_identity_pubkey, "st", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: st_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_review"), content: tx_id_with_nonce)
Niso receives tx_id_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_st from Boomlet and forwards it to ST.
ST receives tx_id_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_st from Niso, decrypts it, separates the nonce and sends the tx_id to User.

tx_id_with_nonce := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(st_0_identity_privkey, "st", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: st_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_review"), envelope: tx_id_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_st)
User receives tx_id from ST and checks to see if it matches that of the psbt he generated. User then informs ST of his acknowledgement of tx_id.
ST then signs the tx_id_with_nonce it received with st_privkey and encrypts it with boomlet_0_identity_pubkey. It then sends this encrypted

tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_0 := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(st_0_identity_privkey, "st", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: st_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_review_approval"), content: tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st)
Niso receives tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_0 from ST and forwards it to Boomlet.
Boomlet receives tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_0 from Niso, decrypts it, verifies st_0_identity_pubkey's signature

and checks if the content is the same as the one sent i.e. User has acknowledged the tx_id and the message is fresh. Boomlet then creates initiator_approval_nonce and computes withdrawal_id. It then generates
peer_0_tx_approval containing withdrawal_id, initiator_approval_nonce, and event_block_height, signs it with boomlet_0_identity_privkey and encrypts it for wt. It
then encrypts psbt for every other boomlet_i using withdrawal_id-bound envelopes. Boomlet sends withdrawal_id, the resulting psbt_encrypted_collection,

tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", st_0_identity_pubkey, "st", sender_public_key: st_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_review_approval"), envelope: tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_0)
withdrawal_id := tagged_sha256("Boomerang/withdrawal_id", canonical_encode(setup_instance_id, tx_id, boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, initiator_approval_nonce))

_peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", wt_pubkey, "wt", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_approval", withdrawal_id), content: peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0)

psbt_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_boomlet_i := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", boomlet_i_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_i_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_psbt", withdrawal_id), content: psbt) [1 <= i <= 4]
from Boomlet and forwards them to WT.

from Niso. WT decrypts peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt using canonical context {"withdrawal_tx_approval", withdrawal_id}, verifies boomlet_0_identity_pubkey's signature,
checks that the signed peer_0_tx_approval carries the same withdrawal_id, and checks that the event_block_height is fresh.
Then it constructs its own wt_tx_approval containing withdrawal_id and most_work_bitcoin_block_height and signs it.
It sends to each non-initiator peer wt_tx_approval_signed_by_wt, peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0 and psbt encrypted by that peer's boomlet_identity_pubkey.

peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0 := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(wt_privkey, "wt", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_approval", withdrawal_id), envelope: peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt)
WT collects one valid peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i from every active setup peer, sorts the valid approvals into ordered_peer_tx_approvals in active setup peer order,
and derives ordered_non_initiator_peer_tx_approvals := ordered_peer_tx_approvals[1..4]. Each receiver verifies this WT-supplied ordering before computing approved_withdrawal_id.

peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(wt_privkey, "wt", peer_ids_collection[i].boomlet_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: peer_ids_collection[i].boomlet_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_approval", withdrawal_id), envelope: peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i_encrypted_by_boomlet_i_for_wt) [1 <= i <= 4]
ordered_peer_tx_approvals := Collection<peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i> [0 <= i <= 4] sorted in active setup peer order by peer_ids_collection
Assert ordered_peer_tx_approvals contains exactly one approval per active setup peer
Assert ordered_peer_tx_approvals has no missing peers and no duplicate signers
Niso receives {ordered_peer_tx_approvals, wt_tx_approval_signed_by_wt} from WT. Niso verifies each
boomlet_i_identity_pubkey's signature on each peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i and verifies wt_pubkey's signature on wt_tx_approval_signed_by_wt.

It checks withdrawal_id to match what was sent, the event_block_heights to be in the appropriate range, and ordered_peer_tx_approvals to contain exactly one approval per active setup peer in peer_ids_collection order.
It computes approved_withdrawal_id from withdrawal_id and ordered_peer_tx_approvals for local tracking, then forwards ordered_peer_tx_approvals with the latest block to Boomlet.
from Niso. Boomlet verifies each boomlet_i_identity_pubkey's signature on each peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i, verifies wt_pubkey's

signature on wt_tx_approval_signed_by_wt and updates niso_0_event_block_height with the new value. It checks withdrawal_id to match what was sent, the event_block_heights to be in the appropriate range, and ordered_peer_tx_approvals to contain exactly one approval per active setup peer in peer_ids_collection order. It computes approved_withdrawal_id from withdrawal_id and ordered_peer_tx_approvals. It then generates
duress_check_space as one randomly sorted list of integers from 1 to 193, including all elements of 1..193, adds a nonce to it and encrypts it. Then Boomlet sends

duress_check_space_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_st := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", st_0_identity_pubkey, "st", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: st_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_challenge"), content: duress_check_space_with_nonce)
Niso receives duress_check_space_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_st from Boomlet and forwards it to ST.
ST receives duress_check_space_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_st from Niso, decrypts it to get duress_check_space_with_nonce,
maps each integer in duress_check_space through DURESS_DISPLAY_VOCABULARY, creates 5 independently shuffled display columns
from the single received list, and keeps display-to-original-index mappings locally.

duress_check_space_with_nonce := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(st_0_identity_privkey, "st", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: st_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_challenge"), envelope: duress_check_space_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_st)
User receives 5 independently shuffled columns from ST. If he is not being coerced he will select 1 country in each column to replicate the duress_consent_set
ST receives the displayed selections from User, converts them into indices in Boomlet's original single list, then creates
duress_signal_index_with_nonce using the nonce from previously received duress_check_space_with_nonce, encrypts it for Boomlet and sends it to Niso.

duress_signal_index_with_nonce_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_0 := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(st_0_identity_privkey, "st", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: st_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_response"), content: duress_signal_index_with_nonce)
Niso receives duress_signal_index_with_nonce_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_0 from ST and forwards it to Boomlet.
Boomlet receives duress_signal_index_with_nonce_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_0 from Niso. Boomlet rejects no outstanding duress check, wrong phase, duplicate response,
wrong nonce, wrong count, duplicate indices, or out-of-range indices. If valid, Boomlet resolves the returned original-list indices against the single list in duress_check_space
assigning the resulting integers to duress_signal.
If the duress_signal is composed of the same set of numbers as the duress_consent_set,
duress_placeholder_plaintext will be assigned all-zero 32-byte padding otherwise it will be the doxing_key_for_sar. duress_placeholder_plaintext will be encrypted
to make up an approved_withdrawal_id-bound duress_placeholder. Boomlet then constructs peer_0_tx_commit containing approved_withdrawal_id and niso_0_event_block_height,
signs it, pads it with duress_placeholder, re-signs it and encrypts it with wt_pubkey and sends the result to Niso.

duress_signal_index_with_nonce := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", st_0_identity_pubkey, "st", sender_public_key: st_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_response"), envelope: duress_signal_index_with_nonce_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_0)
Assert outstanding duress check exists for current phase
duress_placeholder_plaintext := Evaluate(duress_signal, duress_consent_set, doxing_key_for_sar) [either all-zero 32-byte padding or doxing_key_for_sar]

duress_placeholder := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", sar_pubkey, "sar", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: sar_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_placeholder", approved_withdrawal_id), content: duress_placeholder_plaintext)

_peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", wt_pubkey, "wt", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_commit", approved_withdrawal_id), content: _peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0)
Niso receives peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt from Boomlet and forwards it to WT.

WT receives peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt from Niso. It decrypts the message from Niso to get peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0
and verifies boomlet_0_identity_pubkey's signature. It then derives duress_placeholder by separating the padding from _peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded
and sends it to SAR. It also saves peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0 for later.

_peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0 := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(wt_privkey, "wt", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_commit", approved_withdrawal_id), envelope: _peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt)
SAR receives {duress_placeholder, boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, approved_withdrawal_id} from WT. It decrypts duress_placeholder using the Boomlet-to-SAR CBC/CMAC envelope context and
sar_privkey to get duress_placeholder_plaintext. It classifies the plaintext as valid safe if it is all-zero 32-byte padding, valid duress if its derived doxing_data_identifier exists,
or malformed otherwise. If it was valid duress and the tuple of approved_withdrawal_id, the received boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, and envelope IV of duress_placeholder was not previously saved, it uses
duress_placeholder_plaintext which is equal to doxing_key_for_sar to decrypt the associated static_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar and

dynamic_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar. It then uses this doxing_data to enter SEARCH AND RESCUE. For valid safe or duress placeholders, SAR signs duress_placeholder with sar_privkey and encrypts it with
boomlet_0_identity_pubkey. Malformed placeholders are rejected before any acknowledgment is created.

duress_placeholder_plaintext := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(sar_privkey, "sar", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: sar_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_placeholder", approved_withdrawal_id), envelope: duress_placeholder)
[SEARCH AND RESCUE [is_valid_duress_placeholder and (approved_withdrawal_id, boomlet_identity_pubkey, duress_placeholder.iv) not previously saved]]

static_doxing_data := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: derive_cbc_cmac_keys(doxing_key_for_sar, "Boomerang/sar_stored_data"), context: canonical_encode("sar_static_data", doxing_data_identifier), envelope: static_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar)

dynamic_doxing_data := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: derive_cbc_cmac_keys(doxing_key_for_sar, "Boomerang/sar_stored_data"), context: canonical_encode("sar_dynamic_data", doxing_data_identifier), envelope: dynamic_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar)

duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_0 := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(sar_privkey, "sar", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: sar_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_sar_placeholder_response", approved_withdrawal_id), content: duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar)
WT receives duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_0 from SAR and continues processing peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0.
It verifies boomlet_0_identity_pubkey's signature on peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0, checks approved_withdrawal_id to be the one
expected and event_block_height to be fresh. WT then signs peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0 with wt_privkey and sends it to non-initiator
peers. WT receives each peer i's peer_i_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_i in response and checks its correctness in a similar manner. WT then sends
the collection of peer_i_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_i to Niso alongside duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_0.
from WT. It then verifies wt_pubkey's signature on peer_i_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_i_signed_by_wt, each non-initiator peer i's
boomlet_i_identity_pubkey's signature on peer_i_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_i, approved_withdrawal_id to be the one expected, and event_block_height to be fresh.
duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_0 and the latest block height it sees as niso_0_event_block_height to Boomlet.
verifies sar_pubkey's signature on duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar and checks to see if the content matches of the duress_placeholder that it had
sent to WT. It then verifies wt_pubkey's signature on peer_i_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_i_signed_by_wt, each non-initiator peer i's boomlet_i_identity_pubkey's
signature on peer_i_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_i, approved_withdrawal_id to be the one expected, and event_block_height to be fresh according to niso_0_event_block_height.
After that Boomlet initializes counter with 0, reached_boomlets_collection with an empty set,

ping_seq_num with 0, reached_mystery_flag with 0, sets last_seen_block to niso_0_event_block_height. Boomlet then constructs Ping containing approved_withdrawal_id, last_seen_block, ping_seq_num, and reached_mystery_flag,

signs it with boomlet_0_identity_privkey, freshly re-encrypts the current duress_placeholder_plaintext for SAR, pads the ping with this new duress_placeholder, signs peer_0_ping_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded with boomlet_0_identity_privkey, encrypts the result with wt_pubkey and sends

duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", sar_pubkey, "sar", sender_public_key: sar_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_sar_placeholder_response", approved_withdrawal_id), envelope: duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_0)

duress_placeholder := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", sar_pubkey, "sar", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: sar_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_placeholder", approved_withdrawal_id), content: duress_placeholder_plaintext)

peer_0_ping_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_0_identity_privkey, "boomlet", wt_pubkey, "wt", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_ping", approved_withdrawal_id), content: _peer_0_ping_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0)
Niso receives peer_0_ping_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt from Boomlet and forwards it to WT.
[PING_PONG_LOOP until WT has Collection<peer_i_id, peer_i_reached_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i> for every peer_i_id in peer_ids]
peer_i_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i_padded_signed_by_boomlet_i_encrypted_by_boomlet_i_for_wt from Peers). If this is the first ping received, WT
initializes reached_pings_collection with an empty set and goes into a loop that ends when reached_pings_collection[peer_i_id] has a valid value
for every peer. WT decrypts peer_i_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i_padded_signed_by_boomlet_i and verifies boomlet_i_identity_pubkey's signature. Wt then
separates duress_placeholder, which is the padding, and peer_i_ping. This diagram expands only peer 0's SAR path: WT sends peer 0's duress_placeholder and
boomlet_0_identity_pubkey to peer 0's SAR. Other peers' placeholders are routed to their own setup-bound SARs in the corresponding peer flows.
if for peer_i_id in peer_ids reached_pings_collection[peer_i_id] exists:

peer_i_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i_padded_signed_by_boomlet_i := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(wt_privkey, "wt", boomlet_i_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_i_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_ping", approved_withdrawal_id), envelope: peer_i_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i_padded_signed_by_boomlet_i_encrypted_by_boomlet_i_for_wt)
Expanded path for peer 0 only. For peer i, WT sends peer_i's duress_placeholder with boomlet_i_identity_pubkey to peer i's selected SAR.
SAR receives {duress_placeholder, boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, approved_withdrawal_id} from WT. It decrypts duress_placeholder using the Boomlet-to-SAR CBC/CMAC envelope context and sar_privkey
to get duress_placeholder_plaintext. It classifies the plaintext as valid safe if it is all-zero 32-byte padding, valid duress if its derived doxing_data_identifier exists,
or malformed otherwise. If it was valid duress and the tuple of approved_withdrawal_id, the received boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, and envelope IV of duress_placeholder was not previously saved, it uses

duress_placeholder_plaintext which is equal to doxing_key_for_sar to decrypt the associated static_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar and dynamic_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar. It then uses
this doxing_data to enter SEARCH AND RESCUE. For valid safe or duress placeholders, SAR signs duress_placeholder with sar_privkey and encrypts it with boomlet_0_identity_pubkey.
Malformed placeholders are rejected before any acknowledgment is created.

duress_placeholder_plaintext := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(sar_privkey, "sar", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: sar_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_placeholder", approved_withdrawal_id), envelope: duress_placeholder)
[SEARCH AND RESCUE [is_valid_duress_placeholder and (approved_withdrawal_id, boomlet_identity_pubkey, duress_placeholder.iv) not previously saved]]

static_doxing_data := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: derive_cbc_cmac_keys(doxing_key_for_sar, "Boomerang/sar_stored_data"), context: canonical_encode("sar_static_data", doxing_data_identifier), envelope: static_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar)

dynamic_doxing_data := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: derive_cbc_cmac_keys(doxing_key_for_sar, "Boomerang/sar_stored_data"), context: canonical_encode("sar_dynamic_data", doxing_data_identifier), envelope: dynamic_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar)

duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_0 := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(sar_privkey, "sar", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: sar_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_sar_placeholder_response", approved_withdrawal_id), content: duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar)
WT receives duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_0 from SAR and continues processing peer_0_ping_signed_by_boomlet_0 and peer_i_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i.
It verifies boomlet_i_identity_pubkey's signature on peer_i_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i and checks approved_withdrawal_id to be the one expected.
If this is not the first ping It also checks that the ping_seq_num has been increased. Using peer_i_ping.last_seen_block, it
checks that the ping is fresh and if it's the first ping received it checks that the reached_mystery_flag is not 1. If the mystery_flag is 1,
WT assigns peer_i_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i to reached_pings_collection[peer_i_id]. WT constructs pong containing approved_withdrawal_id,

If the duress_signal is composed of the same set of numbers as the

duress_placeholder_plaintext := Evaluate(duress_signal, duress_consent_set, doxing_key_for_sar) [either all-zero 32-byte padding or doxing_key_for_sar]
Regardless of whether a new duress procedure ran, Boomlet freshly encrypts duress_placeholder_plaintext with sar_pubkey to get duress_placeholder. It then checks to see
if the conditions for incrementing counter are met namely if block_heights of last_seen_block, niso_0_event_block_height and
prev_ping.last_seen_block are within a certain boundary. If for any of the peer_i_ids not appeared in reached_boomlets_collection,
prev_ping_i contains 1-valued reached_mystery_flag, Boomlet assigns prev_ping_i_signed_by_boomlet_i to reached_boomlets_collection[peer_i_id].
If Boomlet's own counter has reached its mystery it updates reached_mystery_flag value to 1. It then updates the last_seen_block by taking the
minimum of the current niso_0_event_block_height and the last_seen_block + 10. Boomlet then regenerates ping with incremented ping_seq_num,
signs it with boomlet_0_identity_privkey, pads it with duress_placeholder, resigns it, encrypts it with wt_pubkey and sends the resulting

if last_seen_block != niso_0_event_block_height && prev_ping_i.last_seen_block >= (niso_0_event_block_height - TOLERANCE_IN_BLOCKS_FROM_CREATING_PING_BY_OTHER_PEERS_TO_REVIEWING_THE_PING_IN_PEER_BOOMLET) && prev_ping_i.last_seen_block <= niso_0_event_block_height :

Niso receives peer_0_ping_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt from Boomlet and forwards it to WT.
WT receives peer_0_ping_signed_by_boomlet_0_padded_signed_by_boomlet_0_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_wt from Niso and jumps back to the beginning
of the PING_PONG_LOOP. if the loop breaks WT sends its reached_pings_collection to all Peers.
Niso receives reached_pings_collection from WT. It verifies that the collection contains exactly one current reached ping from every active peer, in active setup peer order, with valid signatures,

expected approved_withdrawal_id, current ping sequence, fresh last_seen_block, and reached_mystery_flag set. Only after those checks does Niso hydrate the PSBT without changing the transaction semantics or tx_id, then sends reached_pings_collection and hydrated_psbt to Boomlet.
Assert reached_pings_collection contains exactly one peer_i_reached_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i for each peer_ids_collection[i] [0 <= i <= 4]
Assert peer_i_reached_ping.last_seen_block is fresh for current block view [0 <= i <= 4]
Assert reached_pings_collection has no missing peers and no duplicate signers
Boomlet receives {reached_pings_collection, hydrated_psbt} from Niso. Boomlet independently verifies that every active peer has exactly one current reached ping for approved_withdrawal_id,

with current ping sequence, fresh last_seen_block, and reached_mystery_flag set. It then verifies the hydrated PSBT preserves the committed tx_id and remains spendable by the Boomerang descriptor before entering signing.
Assert reached_pings_collection contains exactly one peer_i_reached_ping_signed_by_boomlet_i for each peer_ids_collection[i] [0 <= i <= 4]
Assert peer_i_reached_ping.last_seen_block is fresh for current block view [0 <= i <= 4]
Assert reached_pings_collection has no missing peers and no duplicate signers
Niso receives {magic: "withdrawal_ready_to_sign"} from Boomlet and proceeds to inform User to connect Boomlet to Iso.
User receives {magic: "withdrawal_ready_to_sign_received_connect_boomlet_to_iso"} from Niso and proceeds to connect Boomlet to Iso and input
network, mnemonic and passphrase to Iso.
Iso receives {network, mnemonic, passphrase} from User, reconstructs the normal private key and normal public key, and proceeds to inform Boomlet that they can start the MuSig2 protocol for tx_ins
Boomlet receives {magic: "withdrawal_initialized_start_signing"} from Iso and proceeds to share with it the information necessary for
signing i.e. psbt, boomerang_descriptor, boomlet_0_boom_musig2_pubkey_share, alongside his own public nonce named pubnonce_boom.
Iso receives {psbt, boomerang_descriptor, boomlet_0_boom_musig2_pubkey_share, pubnonce_boom} from Boomlet. Iso then generates its own public
nonce and sends this pubnonce_normal alongside his partialsignature (partialsig_normal) to Boomlet.
partialsig_normal := musig2_partial_sign(normal_privkey_0, psbt, boomerang_descriptor, pubnonce_normal, pubnonce_boom, boomlet_0_boom_musig2_pubkey_share)
Boomlet receives {pubnonce_normal, partialsig_normal} from Iso, proceeds to produce its own partial signature and shares it with Iso.
Boomlet saves signed psbt on its own memory.
Assert musig2_verify_partial(normal_pubkey_0, partialsig_normal, psbt, pubnonce_normal, pubnonce_boom) == True
partialsig_boom := musig2_partial_sign(boomlet_0_boom_musig2_privkey_share, psbt, boomerang_descriptor, pubnonce_boom, pubnonce_normal, normal_pubkey_0)
Iso receives partialsig_boom from Boomlet. Iso also keeps signed psbt but informs User that he can connect Boomlet to Niso.
Assert musig2_verify_partial(boomlet_0_boom_musig2_pubkey_share, partialsig_boom, psbt, pubnonce_boom, pubnonce_normal) == True

Boomlet receives {magic: "withdrawal_signing_finished_export_signed_psbt"} from Niso and proceeds to respond to Niso with psbt_signed_by_peer_0.
It also clears its memory of other withdrawal-specific information and regenerates mystery.
withdrawal_clear() [reset memory back to pre-withdrawal except psbt_signed_by_peer_0]
Niso receives psbt_signed_by_peer_0 from Boomlet and forwards it to WT.
WT receives psbt_signed_by_peer_0 from Niso and psbt_signed_by_peer_i [1 <= i <= 4] from Peers. WT verifies that every signed PSBT fragment belongs to the approved withdrawal transaction,
aggregates the signed PSBTs, verifies the final transaction tx_id, and relays the resulting tx_signed_by_peers to the network.
Assert psbt_signed_by_peer_i belongs to approved_withdrawal_id [0 <= i <= 4]
